approvedConciseClaim: In a moderated directional usability study with five participants, median task time was 18 seconds with JobPilot versus 39 seconds with a traditional posting. Factual accuracy was 100% versus 75%.
approvedSupportingClaim: Participants also reported higher confidence and clarity in the JobPilot condition.
approvedCompleteClaim: In a moderated directional usability study with five participants, the JobPilot condition had a median task time of 18 seconds versus 39 seconds for the traditional posting condition. Factual accuracy was 100% versus 75%, while average confidence increased from 3.8 to 6.0 out of 7 and clarity increased from 3.6 to 6.2 out of 7. All participants completed the traditional condition first, so the results are directional and may include an order effect.
requiredLimitation: All participants completed the traditional posting condition first and JobPilot second. Different roles prevented same-role carryover, but practice or order effects may contribute to the observed difference.
prohibitedClaims: validated by five independent external organizations
